newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG'S LAMA OUT FOR UP TO TWO MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG'S LAMA OUT FOR UP TO TWO MONTHS.

text.p: Paris St Germain's international goalkeeper Bernard Lama, injured in a league match in Cannes on Sunday, will be out of action for up to two months, a team doctor said on Tuesday.
Lama, who injured his right knee after stopping a penalty in the 1-0 victory, may miss 11 league matches as well as PSG's next European Cup Winners' Cup games.
He is also unlikely to be fit for France's friendlies against Turkey on October 9 and Denmark a month later.
Lama, who had not conceded a goal in seven matches since the league season resumed, will be replaced by 21-year-old Vincent Fernandez.
